newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly lower on Monday, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 581.71, down from 582.61 on Friday.
Volume was 2.04 million dinars against 2.22 million dinars. Main deals were on the over-the-counter market with a turnover of 1.38 million dinars.
UBCI bank fell 1.61 dinar to 52.03 dinars.
